title: Design System: Australia.md — The Sovereign Archive

display.purpose: Page titles and hero headings. Space Grotesk 700, tracking held at -0.03em.

headline.purpose: Section titles (FAQ, content blocks). Space Grotesk 600.

title.purpose: Card and clinic names. Space Grotesk 600.

body.purpose: Prose and meta. Inter 400, line-height 1.6, measure capped 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, service labels, breadcrumbs, badge text. Inter 600, 0.1em tracking, uppercase.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Cards on hover, paired with a -2 to -4px translateY. Deep diffuse vault-green depth; state only, never at rest.

shadows.name: focus-ring-lift
shadows.purpose: Inputs on focus-within: soft green halo plus depth.

shadows.name: floating-panel
shadows.purpose: Hero search bar and autocomplete dropdown that float above the page.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: hover tints, small transforms, chip/tab state.

motion.name: transition-base
motion.purpose: Default for surface, button, and input state transitions.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal fade-in-up; enhances already-visible content, with prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

components.name: Primary Button (Gold CTA)
components.description: The single decisive action per view. Gold fill, flips to deep green on hover.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with a green-tinted hairline border; warms green on hover.

narrative.overview: This is the visual language of a national institutional record, not a website that happens to hold facts. Every surface is a dark forest-green plate in a deep vault (#0a160f); information sits on it with the calm authority of an official register. Depth is built from a tonal ramp of near-black greens, never from glow or gloss. The two accents are deliberately national: Australian Green for structure, navigation, and trust signals; Australian Gold for the single most important action on a screen. Steel blue is reserved for tertiary data. The system commits to dark mode only because the archive is a vault: a screen of dense, citable data read with focus, where a deep ground lets green and gold carry meaning instead of decoration. Type is a contrast pair: Space Grotesk for headings, Inter for dense body and labels. Motion is restrained. It rejects tourist-brochure gloss, generic SaaS-dashboard templates, and government-portal sterility alike.
keyCharacteristics: Dark forest-green vault ground; depth via tonal layering, not shadow.
National Green & Gold accents, used sparingly and meaningfully.
Dense information, disciplined hierarchy, generous breathing room.
WCAG 2.1 AA / WAI-ARIA 1.2 as a floor, not a feature.

rules.name: The Gold-For-One Rule
rules.body: Australian Gold (#fecc00) fills exactly one action per view — the primary task. If two gold buttons appear on a screen, one of them is wrong. Everything else that needs emphasis uses green.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: There are no pure grays and no pure white. Every neutral is pulled toward the forest-green hue. Pure #000/#fff/#808080 are prohibited; they read as a different, colder product.

rules.name: The -0.03em Floor
rules.body: Display tracking never goes below -0.03em. Tighter and the grotesque caps collide; the archive should read as engraved, not cramped.

rules.name: The One-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels are structural captions, not a per-section reflex. Don't stack a tiny uppercase kicker above every heading.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for the surface-container ramp before reaching for a shadow. If two elements need separating, change the plate, don't add a drop shadow. Shadows are a response to state, never decoration at rest.

rules.name: The Ghost-Card Ban
rules.body: Never combine a 1px border with a wide soft drop shadow on the same resting element. Pick tonal layering + hairline outline; let shadow belong to hover/focus.

dos: Do keep the body ground on the forest-green vault (#0a160f) and build depth from the surface-container ramp before reaching for any shadow.
Do reserve Australian Gold (#fecc00) for exactly one primary action per view; use green for every other emphasis.
Do keep all neutrals tinted toward the green hue — off-white ink (#d8e6da), never pure #fff; hairline borders in rgba green, never pure gray.
Do pair Space Grotesk display with Inter body, and hold display tracking at -0.03em (never tighter).
Do surface trust state plainly — 'AHPRA Unverified' in muted gold — because honesty over polish is the brand.
Do meet WCAG 2.1 AA: body >=4.5:1, large text >=3:1, visible focus rings, descriptive anchor text, prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks, no horizontal scroll to ~320px.
donts: Don't ship tourist-brochure aesthetics — no stock travel photography, no cheerful marketing gloss.
Don't ship a generic SaaS dashboard — no hero-metric template, no endless identical card grids, no purple-gradient startup sheen.
Don't ship government-portal sterility — never cold, cramped, or form-heavy.
Don't combine a 1px border with a wide soft drop shadow on a resting card or button (the ghost-card pattern).
Don't over-round: cards top out at 16px; pills only for tags/badges. No 24/28/32px card radii.
Don't use gradient text, border-left/right color stripes as accents, or decorative glassmorphism (the blurred autocomplete panel is the one sanctioned glass surface).
Don't introduce a second gold action, pure black/white/gray, or a font that's a near-twin of Space Grotesk or Inter.
